name: Relay v0.15 blind English correction corpus

provenance.authorship: Internally authored by an independent task agent; no external source, external model, or external benchmark was used.
provenance.author_access: The author read only examples/evaluate_corrections_v014.py for schema and scoring, plus canonical seed utterances supplied by the coordinating agent. The author did not inspect memory.py, prior test cases, or prior correction corpora/results.
provenance.freeze_contract: Freeze these bytes before implementation scoring. Preserve original labels and report any later label adjudication separately.
provenance.grading: The evaluator merges expected changes into the observed seeded baseline; known casing variants are equivalent. Uncertain cases preserve all active values and require only unresolved-correction flags for the named targets. Abstention cases preserve active values without pending flags.
